responsibility: This file implements the checking-build test harness subclass for GCC diagnostics. It defines selftest::test_diagnostic_context, initializing a diagnostic_context with caret, label, column, and span-printing settings suitable for tests and overriding the span callback to hide real temporary filenames behind a fixed placeholder so diagnostic output can be compared deterministically.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file contains the executable implementation of the selftest diagnostic helper declared in gcc/selftest-diagnostic.h, specifically the constructor/destructor setup and the start_span callback that rewrites filenames to a fixed placeholder for deterministic test output.
